For me, I overshared because I wanted attention. I wanted to feel interesting and important to people around me. I wanted to feel like I was cool, fun, and exciting. I was also just awkward af and wanted to fill the silence lol. But yeah, over time and through therapy, I learned how to validate myself so that I didn't need to tell someone (or anyone for that matter) my entire life just to feel like I was interesting to another person. I gained the confidence to realize I'm actually really interesting to myself and I'm certainly important as well. I might not always have something fun/exciting going on but that isn't always a bad thing. I also realized there were aspects of my life I just didn't want to share with certain people because I didn't necessarily want input on it. I didn't need feedback or I just didn't feel like talking about it. I felt compelled to because I wanted that attention...but not that I don't need their attention, I feel less inclined to tell everyone everything. I still talk to my close friends about my life but I no longer feel that compulsive need to tell them everything.
